dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Mm. Then let's give our vocal cords a rest.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Grab some coffee, and spend some time thinking about the things you're usually too busy for.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Having a challenging mid-to-long-term goal is a good thing.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: This applies equally to combat, job-seeking, and the pursuit of knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But what people get out of achieving their goal depends on the individual.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Storybooks, mostly. A rare sight in the House of Daena — they claim it would distract the students from their studies.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: But if the fate of a student's studies depends on externally imposed restrictions, whether to storybooks or otherwise, they won't make it far in academia.
